raw_text: Chinese defence forums buzzing about reported detection of Indian SSBN INS Arihant in Bay of Bengal. PLA Navy apparently used SOSUS-equivalent fixed sonar arrays to track the submarine. If confirmed, this has major implications for India's nuclear deterrent — the whole point of an SSBN is stealth. Simultaneously, a PLAN Type 093 Shang-class SSN has been spotted via satellite in the eastern Indian Ocean, possibly deployed as a trailing asset.
clean_text: Chinese forums report detection of INS Arihant using fixed sonar arrays. PLA Navy SOSUS-equivalent system allegedly used. Major implications for India nuclear deterrent if stealth compromised. PLAN Type 093 SSN spotted via satellite in eastern Indian Ocean as possible trailing asset.
